name: Illuminati
overview: Scripture warns believers to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding, especially when confronted with fears of secret alliances or conspiracies, as seen in Isaiah's counsel against fearing confederacies. The illuminati conspiracy, often linked with worldly power and deception, echoes the devil's temptation in Matthew where all kingdoms and their glory are shown as a lure. Christians are called to hate evil and rely on God's protection rather than be swayed by human teachings or false signs, recognizing that false prophets and deceptive doctrines can even attempt to deceive the elect. True worship must be grounded in God's Word, not in human traditions or fear of hidden powers.
